integrity: The general random feasible-edge method, labeled graph symmetry, and independent Bernoulli Poisson approximation are established tools; no independent verification or novelty certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The all-parameter formula covers labeled K_a join independent K_b with integers \(2\le a\le b\) and uniform feasible-edge choices. The explicit deficit Poisson error assumes \(b\ge4a\). No claim of optimal error constants, extensions to weighted or vertex-first algorithms, or settled historical priority is made.
title: Sharp quadratic Poisson optimality threshold for greedy split-graph matchings
